Purchase questions

Good to know before checkout

Contact support
Does this product include paid channels or streaming subscriptions?

No. CRTL U Digital sells the hardware only. Use official apps and your own valid subscriptions. No IPTV access, paid channel bundle, or unofficial streaming account is included.

Which power adapter plug should I choose?

Choose the wall-plug type used at the delivery destination: UK Plug (BS 1363), EU Plug (Europlug), or US Plug (NEMA 1-15). The selected type is stored with the order and shown to our fulfillment team.

How much is shipping and how long does delivery take?

Yanwen tracked shipping is USD 12 per order. Orders normally take 1–3 business days to process, followed by an estimated 7–18 business days in transit. Customs or local-carrier delays can extend this estimate.

What happens if the parcel arrives damaged or the wrong item is sent?

Contact support within 7 calendar days after delivery with the order email, shipping-label and packaging photos, and clear photos or video of the issue. We will review the evidence and provide an appropriate solution.

Can I return the product and is there a warranty?

Return requests should be made within 14 calendar days after delivery. Unless a product page states otherwise, physical devices include a 12-month limited hardware warranty for verified manufacturing defects. Policy exclusions apply.

Are Netflix, YouTube, Google TV, or other third-party apps guaranteed?

App availability, certification, playback resolution, subscriptions, and regional restrictions are controlled by each third-party provider and can change. Check the required app and region before purchase if it is essential to your setup.
